_meta._comment: Sample data consumed by the governance.rego policy via `data.governance.deny_list.tools` and `data.governance.deny_list.patterns`. The Rego bundle picks these up automatically; this is the v3.11.1 default deny-list shipped with the EAASP L3 governance. Operators can override the values at deploy time (via the L3 `PUT /v1/policies/managed-hooks` flow) but the schema below is the source of truth for what the policy package expects.

auto_allow._comment: Tools that are auto-allowed regardless of risk_level. Empty by default — the policy relies on `is_read()` + shadow mode for the auto-allow path. Operators can populate this for trusted read-only tools (e.g. `scada_read_snapshot`) but the default v3.11.1 policy treats all non-read tools as approval-required in enforce mode.

obligations_by_risk._comment: Per-risk obligation defaults. The v3.11.1 policy adds `notify:admin` on every approval decision; this map lets the operator override (e.g. add `redact:pii` for write_local) without touching the Rego code.
